hero.subheading: Built on Identification Experience Dating Back to 2014
paragraphs: IDGen is a Guwahati-based identity solutions company serving organizations across Assam and the wider Northeast India market.

Our experience in ID card printing, identification products and organizational supply dates back to 2014. Over the years, we have worked with customers and organizations across Northeast India, gaining practical experience in personalized ID cards, bulk requirements, identification accessories and organizational supply.
IDGen is the next stage of that experience — a dedicated identity-solutions brand focused on bringing products, digital workflows and production together into a more organized identification system.

items.q: Why choose IDGen for organizational ID card and identification projects?
items.a: IDGen focuses specifically on organizational identification, combining personalized ID cards, lanyards, holders, RFID products, accessories and structured production workflows. Its experience dates back to 2014, with a Guwahati-based operation serving organizations across Assam and Northeast India.

items.q: How does IDGen's identification workflow help reduce production errors?
items.a: IDGen follows a structured workflow covering requirements, data preparation, design, preview, approval, production, accessories, quality checking and dispatch. Where applicable, customers can review personalized information before production, helping identify avoidable data, design or specification discrepancies earlier in the process.

items.q: Can IDGen manage the different components of a complete identification setup?
items.a: Yes. Depending on the project, IDGen can coordinate ID cards with custom printed lanyards, card holders, hooks and other identification accessories. This allows organizations to source related components as part of a coordinated identification requirement rather than managing each component separately.

items.q: What makes IDGen suitable for institutional and high-volume identification projects?
items.a: IDGen's workflow is designed around organizational requirements such as bulk quantities, personalized records, approvals, batch production, accessories and quality checking. Production capacity can reach 10,000+ identity products per day depending on the product, personalization, quantity and project requirements.

items.q: Can IDGen support both digital data collection and physical ID card production?
items.a: Yes. For suitable projects, IDGen Studio connects digital identification-data collection and approval with physical ID card production. Organizations can collect required information and photographs, review submissions and approve records before they move into the printing workflow.

items.q: How does IDGen handle customer-provided identification data?
items.a: IDGen treats customer-provided identification information as confidential project material. Organizations should provide only information required for the identification project, use authorized personnel for submission and approval, and follow their applicable privacy and data-handling requirements.

items.q: Does IDGen serve organizations outside Guwahati?
items.a: Yes. IDGen is based in Guwahati, Assam, and serves organizations across Assam and the wider Northeast India market. Dedicated state and city service pages provide more specific information about regional service coverage.

items.q: Can IDGen support identification requirements beyond standard ID cards?
items.a: Yes. Depending on the project, IDGen provides products such as RFID cards, event badges, custom printed lanyards, ID card holders, hooks and other identification accessories. IDGen also offers customized sports medals for suitable institutional, sporting and event requirements.
